name: deploy-center
title: Deploy Center
description: See which Vercel and Render projects have commits waiting, and deploy them by hand with Deploy Center.
author: pschmetzer

commands.name: waiting-deploys
commands.title: Waiting Deploys
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Projects with commits or pull requests that are not live yet. Deploy, open, or copy release notes.

commands.name: deploy-status
commands.title: Deploy Status
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Projects that are building right now, and projects whose newest deploy failed.

commands.name: timeline
commands.title: Timeline
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: What happened in the last 7 days, newest day first: deploys, failures, rollbacks. Only reads.

commands.name: idle-projects
commands.title: Idle Projects
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Projects with no deploy for 90 days or more: candidates to pause. Only reads.

commands.name: deploy-costs
commands.title: Deploy Costs
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: What the next deploy would start and what it would cost (an estimate), per project. Only reads.

commands.name: rollback-preview
commands.title: Rollback Preview
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Pick a project and see which deploy production would go back to. Only reads; a rollback is done in Deploy Center.

commands.name: deploy-all-changed
commands.title: Deploy All Changed
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Shows every project with waiting commits, then deploys all of them after you confirm.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Deploy Center Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: How many projects wait to go live, in the menu bar; red when a newest build failed. Copy a build error from there.

commands.name: costs
commands.title: Costs
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: What Vercel charged this month, by day and by project. Only reads.

commands.name: journal-search
commands.title: Search Journal
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Search the journal of the last 90 days: deploys, failures, rollbacks, forced starts. Only reads.

commands.name: guard-status
commands.title: Guard Status
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Is the guard on, what it did last, the running allowances and whether deploys are closed (deploy freeze). Only reads.

commands.name: costs-menu-bar
commands.title: Deploy Center Costs Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: This month's charges, the deploy freeze and the guard, in the menu bar. Only reads.

commands.name: deploy-project
commands.title: Deploy Project
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Deploy one project by name, after you confirm. Write platform:name when a name is on two platforms.

preferences.name: deploysPath
preferences.title: Path to deploys
preferences.description: Where the deploys CLI is. Leave empty to look in Deploy Center.app (in /Applications or ~/Applications), then on PATH.

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Extra PATH
preferences.description: Folders, separated by colons, where deploys finds vercel, gh and jq. Homebrew's folders are always added.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
